assessmentTiming: Parent acceptance first read after candidate-02 native qualification and input/model freeze.

questions.finding: Boundary includes steward work and coordination; registry and repair outcomes cross actual typed actor/service ports. Logical allocations remain proposed. No physical technology selected.
Actual native fork/join preserves independent registry and inspection contributions, their identified member/tool payloads and conjunction before readiness.
Distinct no-candidate, pending, refused and unfit paths; unfit repeats selection. Wait-list has no inventory reservation; timing/fairness stay unresolved.
Native subject-bound >=2 h requirement is a minimum. Confirmed-delivery origin, withdrawal/new-fault exceptions and reasoned extension are retained; no capacity inference.
Missing confirmation reaches the coordinator contact path and pending-notification state; no assumed delivered timestamp or ordinary expiry from pending notification.
Typed functional flows and native control order preserve matching, acceptance, custody record then on-loan state; return requires steward-confirmed receipt. Unresolved handover remains accountable.
Repair report feeds steward reassessment. Release requires fit evidence and coordinator authority; remaining defects retain quarantine and separate rework/retirement decisions.
Availability lifecycle distinguishes reserved, on-loan, awaiting-assessment and quarantined states, with evidence/decision guards. No claim of proved concurrent implementation.
Complete return-to-availability/recovery slice crosses typed functional exchanges and native logical allocations/interfaces; human operational performance remains distinct.

Planned checks preserve readiness alternatives, confirmed-delivery context, repair-completed-with-defects and unknown sizing. Initial hold setup lacks explicit observations before 2 h and at/after the chosen deadline.

limits: Author-reviewed source meaning against independently prepared questions; not a real practitioner trial, behavioral execution, design approval or all-domain capability proof. The keyword-escaping fix already makes this a regression case for that generator behavior.
